verdict.rationale: Cua documents an official Cua SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust for creating and driving computers from your own code. The docs also cover its runtime backends (Docker/Podman, QEMU, Lume, any OCI image), connecting to remote hosts running cua-spacesd, and streaming sessions back to users. Missing for 10: per-language API reference depth, independent hands-on corroboration of building against the current SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Create and drive computers from your own code. Python, TypeScript and Rust.
the SDK uses Docker or Podman (gVisor when installed), QEMU, or Lume on Apple silicon. Any OCI image works.
Any machine that runs cua-spacesd, such as a spare Mac, a server on your LAN or Tailscale... connects directly by address and env token.
